lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਤੜੀਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin rataReee sahaj mileejai ||
lines.translation: Night and day, imbued with His Love, you shall meet with Him with intuitive ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh sahaj mileejai ros na keejai garab nivaar samaanee ||
lines.translation: In celestial peace and poise, you shall meet Him; do not harbor anger - subdue your proud self!

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachai raatee milai milaaee manamukh aavan jaanee ||
lines.translation: Imbued with Truth, I am united in His Union, while the self-willed manmukhs continue coming and going.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਨਾਚੀ ਤਬ ਘੂਘਟੁ ਕੈਸਾ ਮਟੁਕੀ ਫੋੜਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab naachee tab ghooghat kaisaa matukee phoR niraaree ||
lines.translation: When you dance, what veil covers you? Break the water pot, and be unattached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aapai aap pachhaanai guramukh tat beechaaree ||4||4||
lines.translation: O Nanak, realize your own self; as Gurmukh, contemplate the essence of reality. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: tukhaaree mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Tukhaari, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ਹਮ ਲਾਲਨ ਕੇ ਲਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere laal ra(n)geele ham laalan ke laale ||
lines.translation: O my Dear Beloved, I am the slave of Your slaves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur alakh lakhaaiaa avar na doojaa bhaale ||
lines.translation: The Guru has shown me the Invisible Lord, and now, I do not seek any other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur alakh lakhaaiaa jaa tis bhaaiaa jaa prabh kirapaa dhaaree ||
lines.translation: The Guru showed me the Invisible Lord, when it pleased Him, and when God showered His Blessings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagajeevan daataa purakh bidhaataa sahaj mile banavaaree ||
lines.translation: The Life of the World, the Great Giver, the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, the Lord of the woods - I have met Him with intuitive ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂ ਤਾਰਹਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar karahi too taarahi tareeai sach devahu deen daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: Bestow Your Glance of Grace and carry me across, to save me. Please bless me with the Truth, O Lord, Merciful to the meek.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pranavat naanak daasan daasaa too sarab jeeaa pratipaalaa ||1||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of Your slaves. You are the Cherisher of all souls. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharipur dhaar rahe at piaare ||
lines.translation: My Dear Beloved is enshrined throughout the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੇ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਰੂਪਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabade rav rahiaa gur roop muraare ||
lines.translation: The Shabad is pervading, through the Guru, the Embodiment of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰੂਪ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਾਰੇ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur roop muraare tribhavan dhaare taa kaa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Guru, the Embodiment of the Lord, is enshrined throughout the three worlds; His limits cannot be found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੀ ਜਿਨਸੀ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਏ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਵੈ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)gee jinasee ja(n)t upaae nit devai chaRai savaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He created the beings of various colors and kinds; His Blessings increase day by day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: apara(n)par aape thaap uthaape tis bhaavai so hovai ||
lines.translation: The Infinite Lord Himself establishes and disestablishes; whatever pleases Him, happens.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੀਰਾ ਹੀਰੈ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਕੈ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰੋਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak heeraa heerai bedhiaa gun kai haar parovai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the diamond of the mind is pierced through by the diamond of spiritual wisdom. The garland of virtue is strung. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੁਣਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਣੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gunahi samaane masatak naam neesaano ||
lines.translation: The virtuous person merges in the Virtuous Lord; his forehead bears the insignia of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach saach samaaiaa chookaa aavan jaano ||
lines.translation: The true person merges in the True Lord; his comings and goings are over.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach saach pachhaataa saachai raataa saach milai man bhaavai ||
lines.translation: The true person realizes the True Lord, and is imbued with Truth. He meets the True Lord, and is pleasing to the Lord's Mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saache oopar avar na deesai saache saach samaavai ||
lines.translation: No one else is seen to be above the True Lord; the true person merges in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਖੋਲਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohan mohi leeaa man meraa ba(n)dhan khol niraare ||
lines.translation: The Fascinating Lord has fascinated my mind; releasing me from bondage, He has set me free.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਜਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jotee jot samaanee jaa miliaa at piaare ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, my light merged into the Light, when I met my most Darling Beloved. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਘਰੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਗੁਰ ਥਾਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach ghar khoj lahe saachaa gur thaano ||
lines.translation: By searching, the true home, the place of the True Guru is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh nah paaeeai guramukh giaano ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom, while the self-willed manmukh does not.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੈ ਸਚੁ ਦਾਨੋ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਨੋ ਸਦ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਡ ਦਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: devai sach daano so paravaano sad daataa vad daanaa ||
lines.translation: Whoever the Lord has blessed with the gift of Truth is accepted; the Supremely Wise Lord is forever the Great Giver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਚਿਰਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: amar ajonee asathir jaapai saachaa mahal chiraanaa ||
lines.translation: He is known to be Immortal, Unborn and Permanent; the True Mansion of His Presence is everlasting.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੋਤਿ ਉਚਾਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: dot uchaapat lekh na likheeai pragatee jot muraaree ||
lines.translation: The day-to-day account of deeds is not recorded for that person, who manifests the radiance of the Divine Light of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਰਾਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੀਐ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saachaa saachai raachaa guramukh tareeai taaree ||4||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the true person is absorbed in the True Lord; the Gurmukh crosses over to the other side. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਖਾਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: tukhaaree mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Tukhaari, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਸਮਝੁ ਅਚੇਤ ਇਆਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man meriaa too samajh achet iaaniaa raam ||
lines.translation: O my ignorant, unconscious mind, reform yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਛਡਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man meriaa chhad avagan gunee samaaniaa raam ||
lines.translation: O my mind, leave behind your faults and demerits, and be absorbed in virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਸਾਦ ਲੁਭਾਣੇ ਕਿਰਤ ਕਮਾਣੇ ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu saad lubhaane kirat kamaane vichhuRiaa nahee melaa ||
lines.translation: You are deluded by so many flavors and pleasures, and you act in such confusion. You are separated, and you will not meet your Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਜਮ ਡਰਿ ਮਰੀਐ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu dutar tareeai jam dar mareeai jam kaa pa(n)th duhelaa ||
lines.translation: How can the impassible world-ocean be crossed? The fear of the Messenger of Death is deadly. The path of Death is agonizingly painful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਾਝ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤਾ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਰੁਧਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man raam nahee jaataa saajh prabhaataa avaghat rudhaa kiaa kare ||
lines.translation: The mortal does not know the Lord in the evening, or in the morning; trapped on the treacherous path, what will he do then?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਛੂਟੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵੈ ਨਰਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan baadhiaa in bidh chhootai guramukh sevai narahare ||1||
lines.translation: Bound in bondage, he is released only by this method: as Gurmukh, serve the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਤੂ ਛੋਡਿ ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man meriaa too chhod aal ja(n)jaalaa raam ||
lines.translation: O my mind, abandon your household entanglements.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man meriaa har sevahu purakh niraalaa raam ||
lines.translation: O my mind, serve the Lord, the Primal, Detached Lord.
